message.content:
You can limit the number of splits by passing a second argument to `split`.  
In this case you want to split only on the **first** `=`:

```python
temp = "hello=good="
parts = temp.split('=', 1)   # split at most once
print(parts)                 # ['hello', 'good=']
```

`split('=', 1)` tells Python to split on `'='` but stop after one split, so the remainder of the string (including any additional `=` characters) stays together.
